correctness.rationale: For |E|=3 the six elementary submodularity rows have rank four and exactly two independent difference relations. These give an exhaustive constructive classification of 22 feasible equality sets. Every projection region is an orthogonal row-nullspace projector Q_I; the complete exact-rational 22-case table is 1, 3/2, 5/3 or 7/4, with exactly five maximizers. The full-set negative delta gives slacks (0,1,0,1,0,1) and an interior normal direction at a maximizing face with an explicitly checked row of l1 mass 7/4. The standalone standard-library checker was run successfully against the same file contents. A finite enumerated computation is sufficient here because the 22 cases are analytically proven exhaustive; no conclusion about all ground-set sizes is made.

value.rationale: This is the first interacting three-variable submodularity cone: unlike two variables, six inequalities interact with two linear relations. The exact 7/4 sensitivity modulus and complete 22-pattern/five-sharp-face classification give a motivated sharp stability benchmark for least-squares submodular denoising. The explicit >1 amplification warns that Hilbert nonexpansivity does not imply coordinatewise data stability, and distinguishes the two-variable 3/2 case. The calculation is complete for a natural entire object, not a selected arbitrary slice or a routine scalar substitution.
